what: When the section reaches 70% of the screen, the inner block enters from a spot 100px (phone 40px) away at one of lower left, directly below, or lower right (random each time it opens), then at the 70% point overshoots 40px to the opposite side while squashed to .95 wide · .9 tall (1.1 wide · .8 tall if it comes from the center) and settles into place. Appears over the first 20%, .8s, deceleration of two layered sines (doubleSineOut). Plays once.

options.side: Entry side left · center · right · random, default random (the original randomizes per section on every open)
options.dist: Starting distance (px), default 100 — phone (959px or less) uses dist-sm
options.dist-sm: Initial drop distance on phone (px), default 40
options.over: Distance (px) at the 70% point where it passes to the other side, default 40
options.[data-fx-part=target]: Inner block to move (multiple allowed). If none, the element itself

from.where: home.js .js-c-elastic → .js-c-elastic-target — entrance of every section (left·center·right random, keyframes 0/20/30/70/100, .8s DoubleSineOut, start top 70% once)

note: The original picks a side at random for each section — to measure the same values, fix the side
